answer: The glacier counter is kept in vertex and lantern makes public each reset. Someone as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 202 aliases cost 103 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
